item.title: Preble first half mobile home taxes now payable
item.description: EATON — Preble County Treasurer Shannon Chappel announced that payment for the first half of 2026 mobile home taxes can now be made. When submitting tax payments, taxpayers are required to return the treasurer’s stub with their check. Questions regarding tax bills may be directed to the Preble County Treasurer’s Office. The post Preble first half mobile home taxes now payable appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Preble County grand jury indicts Daniels, others
item.description: EATON — A Preble County grand jury returned multiple indictments during its Monday, Feb. 9 session. Among them was Gabriel Alex Daniels, 22, who was indicted on several felony charges, including attempted murder, in connection with a stabbing incident which occurred Jan. 9.
